positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I work as a full-stack developer doing everything necessary to keep the CareNexus platform running. This includes:
- Managing and deploying our CI/CD pipelines
- Managing our Azure infrastructure using Terraform
- Developing new features for our HAPI FHIR server in Java
- Creating custom microservices in Golang and Typescript to provide new features to the CareNexus platform
- Setup, update, and manage our OAuth identity provider
- A small amount of React development on our frontend when available
- Managing our Kubernetes instance (upgrading, monitoring, etc.)
- Document all of our custom APIs using the OpenAPI specification

positions.title: Software Engineering Aid
positions.description: I worked full time to build a custom layer 2 switch for the US Airforce. I primarily worked in C and Javascript. C was primarily used for the core switching functions and Javascript was used for the management interface.
